query: /handoff after a long conversation with many detours
expected_behavior: Writes handoff-<topic>-<YYYYMMDD-HHmm>.txt with a short lowercase topic
Contains only the current state and what the next chat needs, with no detours or superseded content
Uses uppercase labels, no markdown, and omits empty sections without writing N/A
Each NEXT item is actionable without extra context

query: /handoff in a conversation on any topic that is not code
expected_behavior: Uses the same sections and format
Does not assume a repo, branch or any specific tool

query: /handoff when an earlier decision was replaced midway
expected_behavior: DECISIONS holds only the one in force and why
